routes.name: One Year Residential Certificate (Work from Bermuda)
routes.summary: A one-year certificate to live in Bermuda while working remotely for a company based overseas, or while studying. You can't take a job in Bermuda.

other: Employed by, or own, a firm registered and operating overseas, or enrolled in a research, undergraduate, graduate or doctoral program
Enough means or ongoing income to support your household without working locally
Valid health insurance or buy local coverage
Fee amount in the 2020 policy is outdated, check the current Immigration fee schedule

stay.note: Renewal is not guaranteed. You apply again for each new certificate.

routes.processing: The Department aims to decide within 10 business days of receiving the application.

routes.name: Economic Investment Residential Certificate
routes.summary: A residential certificate for people who invest at least BD$2.5 million in Bermuda. It gives an indefinite right to reside if you keep the investment and meet the stay rule.

investment.note: Real estate, Sinking Fund, Bermuda Trust Fund, registered charity donation, business equity, or another Minister-approved venture

other: Good character, no certain criminal convictions
Keep the investment at BD$2.5 million for five years
Spend at least 90 days in Bermuda each calendar year for those five years

stay.note: Right to reside for an indefinite period while conditions are kept.

steps: Show proof of the qualifying investment, such as a letter of intent
Apply to the Department of Immigration

sources.label: Economic Investment Residential Certificate Policy, June 2024 (gov.bm)

routes.name: Permanent Resident's Certificate (PRC)
routes.summary: Lets a long-term non-Bermudian resident live in Bermuda permanently. Routes include 20 years of residence, being the parent of a child with Bermudian status, or being close family of a PRC holder.

other: 20 years of ordinary residence, including the two years right before applying
Or non-Bermudian parent of a child with Bermudian status, with 15 years of residence including the last two
Or son, daughter or spouse of a PRC holder
Be of good conduct and character
Section 31A route needs 10 years of ordinary residence after at least 10 years exempted under the Economic Development Act 1968
